title: Multi-AZ VPC networking module: gateways, endpoints, and routing orchestration
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module for Private deployments that provisions a production-ready Multi-AZ VPC network. The module must support configurable public/private subnets per AZ, optional per-AZ NAT gateways or a centralized NAT architecture, Internet Gateway (IGW), gateway VPC endpoints (S3/DynamoDB), interface endpoints for required AWS services, route tables and propagation, and health-checking/monitoring hooks. It should be opinionated about secure defaults (restrictive SGs, no public IPs on private subnets) but flexible via inputs for edge cases. Provide a clear upgrade path and migration helpers to replace older in-repo networking stacks without downtime.
acceptance_criteria: Module publishes inputs/outputs documented in README.md and Confluence design doc
Module can deploy into a sandbox account across 3 AZs with default config using terraform plan/apply with no manual steps
Support for optional per-AZ NAT gateways or single centralized NAT with cost toggle
Create gateway endpoints for S3 and DynamoDB when enabled; create interface endpoints with configurable subnets and security groups
Route tables correctly associate private/public subnets and include health-check failover routes for NAT/egress
Include a Terratest suite that validates connectivity (instances in private subnet can reach S3, metadata endpoints unreachable, interface endpoints resolve)
Module includes migration guide and terraform state import snippets for replacing legacy stacks
Security review checklist completed and automated scans pass (tfsec, checkov)
notes: 2026-02-21: Kickoff — alignment with Private Deployments PM on secure defaults and enterprise constraints
2026-02-25: Decided to make per-AZ NAT optional; default is per-AZ to favor predictable latency for KV-cache heavy workloads
2026-03-01: Trade-off: per-AZ NAT increases cost but reduces cross-AZ egress; documented cost estimator in README
2026-03-04: Chose to expose an 'egress_priority' input to toggle failover order between NATs and centralized NAT
2026-03-06: Added health-check design for IAM/endpoint connectivity leveraging ALBs + lambda-based synthetic probes
2026-03-09: Initial PR opened for review with basic resources and examples (see links)
review_feedback: Security team: require default endpoint policies to be restrictive; must document exception process for widening policy
Infra eng: prefer explicit route table per AZ to avoid cross-AZ route churn during upgrades
PM: include cost-estimation section and terraform input to select single vs multi NAT with estimated monthly delta
QA: add terratest scenarios for intermittent network partitions and ensure module re-applies cleanly
migration_plan: 1) Publish module v0.1 and example stacks in sandbox; run integration tests
2) For each in-repo VPC stack: create a migration branch that adds module invocation in parallel and import existing resources using 'terraform import' into module state
3) Run canary migration on non-critical customer VPC in staging, validate connectivity and metrics for 48 hours
4) Flip traffic by updating route table associations to module-managed resources incrementally per-AZ
5) Remove legacy resources and finalize state cleanup
6) Post-migration: run postmortem and update runbook with rollback steps
health_check_design: Synthetic probes: lambda in each AZ that performs S3 put/get via gateway endpoint and reports status to CloudWatch and Grafana
VPC connectivity checks: EC2-based probe in private subnet attempts to resolve and connect to interface endpoints on expected ports
Endpoint ACL monitoring: periodic checks of endpoint policy drift against baseline stored in SSM
Automatic alerts: PagerDuty on probe failure with runbook link and automatic runbook-triggered remediation (reassociate route, recreate NAT)
implementation_tasks: module: vpc/main.tf, subnets.tf, nat.tf, endpoints.tf, rtb.tf, outputs.tf
examples/: minimal, per-az-nat, centralized-nat, hybrid cost-optimized
tests/: terratest suite + terraform validate CI job + tfsec/checkov scanning
docs/: README, migration guide, cost estimator spreadsheet link
observability/: CloudWatch metrics, synthetic probe Lambda, Grafana dashboard
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: State import complexity can cause drift — Mitigation: provide import helper scripts and run 'terraform plan' with detailed review
Risk: Per-AZ NAT increases spend — Mitigation: cost toggle + documentation + tagging for chargeback
Risk: Endpoint policy misconfiguration could expose S3 — Mitigation: default deny policy with explicit allow list and automated baseline checks
Risk: Rollout could cause transient routing loops — Mitigation: per-AZ incremental route re-association and traffic blackholing detection in probes
